name: YCIC Eco-Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: YCIC Eco-Technology Co., Ltd. engages in greening businesses, maintaining public facilities and environment, and ecology repairing. It also includes plant seeds mass production, restoring of parks and gardens, development and application of ecological and environmental friendly products, construction technical consulting, and project investment. The company was founded on June 5, 1996 and is headquartered in Kunming, China.
